name: Tencent Cloud ADP
name_zh: 腾讯云智能体开发平台
desc: Tencent Cloud console for building enterprise AI agents
desc_zh: 腾讯云上的企业智能体开发平台
solves: Wiring an agent stack by hand takes weeks; pick a mode, connect company data, then publish to a channel.
solves_zh: 自己拼装智能体开发环境要花几周，现在选一种模式、连上企业数据就能发布到渠道。
best_for: A company wants one place to build, test and ship agents that answer from its own knowledge base.
best_for_zh: 公司想把智能体的搭建、测试和上线放在一处，并让它用自己的知识库回答问题。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1759/104191 (产品动态), https://cloud）。 Backfill: the platform is absent from the ledger. Release chain taken verbatim from the official product-dynamics page: it first shipped on 2024-04-01 as 大模型知识引擎 (LLM Knowledge Engine, LKE), was renamed to 腾讯云智能体开发平台 (TCADP) in 2025-05, and to Tencent Cloud ADP in 2025-06, so 2024-04-01 is used as the first public availability. ADP 3.0 shipped 2025-09-17 and ADP 4.0 on 2026-06-05 (IT之家). The consumer-side agent platform 腾讯元器 is a separate ledger entry; ADP is the enterprise cloud one. ADP 出海 edition at adp.tencentcloud.com. Not to be confused with 腾讯云知识引擎原子能力, a separate API listing. 首次公开日期来源：https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1759/104191
